entry.title: Lab401 at TROOPERS19
entry.content:
TROOPERS19 just finished - and by all accounts was an incredible experience for everyone involved. 

The legendary Philippe Teuwen @doegox, along with Salvador Mendoza and Nahuel Grisolia gave a two-day workshop on getting dirty with RFID/NFC: Fully loaded and even dirtier. Lab401 was proud to supply  RFID pen-testing - tools for demonstration and assistance with the workshop: the SCL-3711 and the awesome MAGIC NTAG® 21X / NTAG® I2C / MIFARE ULTRALIGHT® EV1 Compatible Emulator tag.
